<title>Red-black tree: black root and red children, one key per node</title>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="778" height="240" rx="10" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<text x="390" y="28" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">Red-Black Tree</text><line x1="390" y1="99" x2="210" y2="166" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="390" y1="99" x2="570" y2="166" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="390" cy="83" r="21" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-text)" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="390" y="88" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)">20</text><circle cx="210" cy="183" r="21" fill="var(--nodal-svg-warning-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-warning)" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="210" y="188" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">10</text><circle cx="570" cy="183" r="21" fill="var(--nodal-svg-warning-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-warning)" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="570" y="188" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">30</text><text x="431" y="84" text-anchor="start" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">B</text><text x="210" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-warning)">RED</text><text x="570" y="230" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-warning)">RED</text><text x="390" y="147" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="500" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">BLACK root</text>
</svg>
